text: Checkout page returns 500 for all users since the 14:20 deploy. Payments are completely down. Rolling back now.
notes: Total failure of revenue path. 'Completely down' + all users = critical, not high.

text: A customer reports the profile picture upload spinner never stops on Safari 16. Works fine in Chrome. Only one report so far.
notes: Single report, one browser, cosmetic path. Low despite being a real bug.

text: Nightly ETL job finished in 4h12m, up from its usual 40 minutes. No failures but it nearly overran the window.
notes: No user impact yet but next run may overrun. High because it is about to break.

text: Can someone remind me where the staging database credentials are documented?
notes: Question, not incident. action_required false because it needs an answer, not an engineering fix.

text: Search results are showing deleted listings again. Same bug as INC-8821 from March which we thought was fixed.
notes: Explicitly a previously-fixed bug returning. Regression, not bug.

text: Disk usage on the log aggregation host hit 82%. Growing about 3% a week. Nothing broken yet.
notes: Predictable exhaustion in ~6 weeks. Medium: needs planning, not paging.

text: Users in the EU are seeing session timeouts after 5 minutes instead of the configured 30. Started this morning. Roughly 15% of EU traffic affected.
notes: Significant regional user impact but service is up. High, not critical.

text: The API docs still show the v1 rate limit of 100 req/min. We moved to 500 in June.
notes: Stale docs. Low severity, still needs a fix.

text: Someone pushed an AWS access key to the public repo about an hour ago. Key has been revoked but we need to audit what it touched.
notes: Credential exposure is critical even after revocation, because blast radius is unknown.

text: Feature request from enterprise customer: they want to export audit logs as CSV rather than JSON.
notes: Not a defect. action_required false: this goes to the backlog, not to an on-call engineer.

text: p99 latency on the recommendations endpoint went from 180ms to 950ms over the last three days. p50 is unchanged at 40ms.
notes: Tail-only degradation. Real but affects a minority; medium.

text: Deploy pipeline has been stuck on 'awaiting runner' for 40 minutes. Nobody can ship.
notes: Internal tooling down. High not critical: no customer impact, but the whole team is blocked.

text: Got a phishing email pretending to be from our own IT team asking for VPN credentials. Reporting it here.
notes: Reported, not clicked. Medium: needs a broadcast warning, not incident response.

text: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for Android 12 users after the 3.4.1 release. Play Store reviews are piling up.
notes: New release broke a whole OS version. Crash on launch = total unusability.

text: The metrics dashboard shows a gap between 02:00 and 02:45 last night. Data seems to have been collected, just not displayed.
notes: Display-only, data intact, historical. Low.

text: We are at 78% of our monthly OpenAI spend with 11 days left in the month.
notes: On pace to overrun. Cost, not availability. Medium.

text: Password reset emails are going to spam for Outlook users. Support has had 40 tickets today.
notes: Blocks account recovery for a large provider. High.

text: What is our current retention policy for user activity logs?
notes: Pure information request.

text: Kafka consumer lag on the events topic is at 2.1 million messages and climbing. Consumers appear healthy.
notes: Growing backlog with no self-correction. High.

text: Minor typo on the pricing page: 'Enterpise' should be 'Enterprise'.
notes: Trivial but customer-visible.

text: Two customers report being charged twice for the same subscription renewal on the 3rd.
notes: Double-charging is critical regardless of count. Money + trust + likely more affected.

text: The staging environment has been down since Friday. Not blocking anyone since everyone is testing locally.
notes: Outage by category, low by severity. Tests that the model does not equate the two.

text: SSL certificate for api.example.com expires in 6 days. Auto-renewal appears to have failed silently.
notes: Known deadline, total outage if missed. High now, critical in 5 days.

text: After the auth service upgrade, SSO login works but users lose their session on every page navigation.
notes: Upgrade-induced, makes the product unusable for SSO users.

text: Can we get a runbook for restoring from the nightly backup? I could not find one during the drill.
notes: Missing DR documentation. Medium: not urgent, but it is a real gap in incident readiness.

text: Image CDN served stale thumbnails for about 20 minutes around 09:15. Cache seems to have self-healed.
notes: Resolved itself, brief, cosmetic. action_required false: nothing to do beyond noting it.

text: Rate limiter is rejecting legitimate traffic from our largest customer. They are getting 429s on maybe a third of requests.
notes: Major customer materially degraded. Critical on business impact.

text: Would it be possible to add dark mode to the admin console?
notes: Enhancement request.

text: Background worker pool is running at 95% utilization during peak hours. Jobs are completing but queue depth spikes.
notes: Headroom nearly gone but currently coping.

text: A dependency scan flagged a high-severity CVE in the image processing library we use. No known exploit in our usage pattern.
notes: Tests whether the model anchors on the CVE's own rating. Our exposure is medium, not high.

text: Database failover triggered at 03:12 and completed in 40 seconds. Replica took over cleanly. No user reports.
notes: Automation worked as designed. action_required false: this is the system behaving correctly.

text: The onboarding email sequence is sending step 3 before step 2 for users who sign up on weekends.
notes: Real, reproducible, limited blast radius.

text: Analytics events have been double-counted since the SDK update on Tuesday. All dashboards are inflated roughly 2x.
notes: Corrupts decision-making data. High, not critical: nothing customer-facing broke.

text: Which team owns the notification service now that the platform team split?
notes: Organisational question.

text: Webhook deliveries to customer endpoints are being retried indefinitely on 4xx responses instead of being dropped.
notes: Wastes resources and spams customers, but nothing is down.

text: Load test at 3x expected peak passed with p99 under 400ms. No errors. Posting for the record.
notes: Informational only. Tests whether the model invents a problem where none exists.

text: Terraform plan wants to destroy and recreate the production RDS instance. Nobody knows why. Not applying until we understand it.
notes: Ambiguous case: categorised as security because it is an unexplained privileged change to production state. Documented because the model may reasonably answer 'bug'.

text: Customer asks whether we support SAML 2.0 or only OIDC for enterprise SSO.
notes: Sales-facing capability question.

text: GraphQL endpoint allows unauthenticated introspection in production. Schema is fully readable by anyone.
notes: Information disclosure, not a breach. High not critical: no data exposed, only structure.

text: Report generation for accounts with more than 50k records times out at the 30 second gateway limit.
notes: Feature is unusable for the largest accounts.
